content.description:
TADA token – TADA – is a Cardano based cryptocurrency token for a fuelling the TADA platform. TADA is a highly functional open source project that banks on blockchain technology’s permissionless nature to provide decentralized finance (DeFi) solutions and other services.

A community-driven token for SPOs of small stake pools to reward longterm delegators with, in addition to staking rewards, to further incentivize delegation.
